about: why an automated kitchen order failed (its job record and log)
description: Diagnose: a cook reads why an order failed (its record, its log and the kitchen code) and explains the fix. Read-only. If a code change would fix it, the answer ends with a goal you can send to Improve with one tap.

args.Prompt:
A kitchen order failed and was set aside. Ticket: {{ticket}}.

What happened (the job record and the end of its log):
{{failure}}

You are in the kitchen's own code (this repository: kitchen/, kitchen/recipes/, kitchen/cooks/). Read what you need to find the real cause. Do not change anything.

Write for Jordan, who reads on his phone, in plain words:
# What broke
Two or three sentences.
# Why
The cause, with the file and line if it is in the code.
# The fix
What should change. If it was a passing hiccup (a cook busy or at its limit, a network blip, the PC asleep), say: Just retry it.
If a change to the kitchen's code or a recipe would fix it, end with exactly one last line:
FIX GOAL: <one sentence goal for the Improve recipe>
